{{Quote|Took your time, my love.|Bhota to Onar Koma|<ref name="Rulebook" />}}
'''Bhota''' was an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and the lover of former [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] member [[Onar Koma/Legends|Onar Koma]]. During Onar Koma's service in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]],<ref name="Rulebook" /> his close friends,<ref name="Extortion">{{SWIA|set=Jabba's Realm|mission=Extortion}}</ref> including Bhota,<ref name="Rulebook" /> were captured by his old rivals who intended to make him pay<ref name="Extortion" /> for his Black Sun [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. Bhota and the others were taken to a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] den<ref name="Rulebook" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]]<ref name="Extortion" /> and locked away in makeshift [[Prison/Legends|cells]].<ref name="Rulebook" />
